description: Driver Licensing - Vehicle on Road Test (VORT) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Infrastructure and Transport. The number of driver license applicants that successfully passed a Vehicle on Road Test (VORT) on their first attempt or on more than one occasion for classes Car, Light Rigid, Medium Rigid, Heavy Rigid, Heavy Combination, R-Date, and Bike. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Its tags are Road Assets, car, drivers license, license, test. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
